command:
set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; DB=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye sh -c 'ls databases 2>/dev/null' | tr -d '\r' | grep -E '\.(db|sqlite)$|tracker|blueeye' | head -n1 || true); test -n "$DB"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat "databases/$DB" > "$OUT/current-db.sqlite"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3, json, hashlib
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"
db=out/"current-db.sqlite"
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{db}?mode=ro', uri=True)
tables={r[0] for r in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")}
print('DB_TABLE_COUNT',len(tables))
if 'devices' in tables:
    total=con.execute('select count(*) from devices').fetchone()[0]
    max_seen=con.execute('select max(lastSeenAt) from devices').fetchone()[0]
    recent=con.execute('select count(*) from devices where lastSeenAt >= ?',((max_seen or 0)-180000,)).fetchone()[0] if max_seen is not None else 0
    print('DEVICE_TOTAL',total)
    print('DENSE_180S_WINDOW_AT_DATASET_TAIL',recent)
else:
    print('DEVICE_TABLE_MISSING')
if 'signal_samples' in tables:
    print('SIGNAL_SAMPLE_TOTAL',con.execute('select count(*) from signal_samples').fetchone()[0])
print('DB_SHA256',hashlib.sha256(db.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
con.close()
PY
rm -f "$OUT/current-db.sqlite"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; echo DATASET_BASELINE_CAPTURE_PASS; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
